scope: Disposable Roblox Studio Edit engines and mocked network boundaries; actual server and client source executed.
cause: Queued market orders have nil Price. MarketServer emit passed this value at index 5 of table.concat, throwing before delivery and interrupting the subscriber broadcast loop.

server.Name: Queued market order serializes and keeps both subscribers live

client.Name: 1000 clicks send only six requests and return clear feedback
Allowance refills; throttled clicks are never replayed
Close and cancel remain available after exhausting the entry burst
